name: sign-in
fixture: workspace member in two workspaces and invited to a third
query: mutation SignIn($email: String!, $password: String!, $captchaToken: String) { signIn(email: $email, password: $password, captchaToken: $captchaToken) { availableWorkspaces { availableWorkspacesForSignIn { id displayName loginToken personalInviteToken inviteHash workspaceUrls { subdomainUrl } logo } availableWorkspacesForSignUp { id displayName loginToken personalInviteToken inviteHash workspaceUrls { subdomainUrl } logo } } tokens { accessOrWorkspaceAgnosticToken { token expiresAt } refreshToken { token expiresAt } } } }
